description: Header file defining the XNNGraph class for building and executing XNNPack graphs within PyTorch's JIT backend, including methods for graph optimization, tensor management, and serialization.

classes.name: XNNGraph
classes.description: Class responsible for constructing, optimizing, and executing XNNPack graphs in the PyTorch JIT backend.

methods.name: buildXNNGraph
methods.description: Builds an XNNPack graph from a Torch JIT graph and example inputs.

methods.name: runGraphOnInputs
methods.description: Executes the XNNPack graph on provided tensor inputs and outputs.

methods.name: serializedXNNGraph
methods.description: Returns a serialized representation of the XNNPack graph.

methods.name: getGraphOutputShapes
methods.description: Retrieves the output shapes of the graph.
